name: iFizBox
subtitle: A package manager with the iOS 6 look
description: iFizBox's own source: the iFizBox app for iPhones without a jailbreak.

apps.name: iFizBox
apps.subtitle: Packages and apps with the iOS 6 look
apps.localizedDescription: iFizBox lists apps from AltStore-style sources and, on a jailbroken iPhone, tweaks and themes from APT repos, with the iOS 6 look. The app signs apps on your iPhone with your own certificate (no server) and scrolls at 120Hz. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.localizedDescription:
Real Liquid Glass bars on iOS 26+, and Open Tailscale without the "Could not sign device" sheet
iOS 26 style in the app on iOS 26+: the tab bar, Search circle and bar buttons are iOS's own Liquid Glass
Open Tailscale opens the app directly instead of Tailscale's "Could not sign device" sheet
iOS 26 style in the app on iOS 26+: the floating tab bar, the Search circle and the nav bar's buttons are drawn by iOS as real Liquid Glass, with its refraction, over the page.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.20.1

iOS 26 style with native controls, Add Tweaks, and installs that fall back to the Signing Server
Theme > Style iOS 26: Liquid Glass bars, and in the app iOS's own switches, alerts, action sheets and scope bar
Add Tweaks page under an app's Details; Manage > Sources picks sources like Installed
This iPhone installs: Tailscale checked first, one pairing at a time, Use the Signing Server when it fails
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.20.0

Cydia-style Details page for packages and apps, and Source links that land on Sources
Packages and apps open a Details page like Cydia's: icon rows, Preview, More Information, Filesystem Content
Website add-source links open the Sources tab with the new source loading there
Home Screen icon follows Theme > Mode; Tailscale names the machine after the phone model
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.19.1

A Glass app icon, wide package rows like Cydia's, and steadier This iPhone copies
Theme > App Icon > Special offers Glass: Classic in Light, Gunmetal in Dark, drawn with the system's glass
Installed and section lists show wide package rows; Install IPAs is a plain row above A in Installed
Author pages open again; price buttons match the iOS 7 and iOS 13 themes
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.19.0

Re-sign without downloading again: each app keeps the IPA it was installed from, and Add Tweaks lists only tweaks for that app.
Re-sign, Re-sign All and the queue sign from the IPA kept at install when it still matches, and each app goes to iOS as soon as it is signed.
Add Tweaks lists tweaks made for the app first (Works in: <app>), then ones for every app; paid Havoc and Chariz tweaks find their seller.
Hold Install on a package or app page to pick which version to install.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.18.4

Installs on This iPhone survive a dropped connection: the copy resumes and a finished install counts as installed.
Leaving the app, locking it or a VPN blip during an install no longer ends in "failed".
Tailscale's Test Connection says Not Paired Yet with a Pair button instead of No Answer.
Apps from a source keep the source's name (RyukGram, not Instagram).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.18.3

iFizBox keeps its own secrets out of reach of other sideloaded apps
Your signing certificate, App Store Connect key and sign-ins are saved where only iFizBox can read them, even when other apps share its signing profile.
Re-signed apps keep their own keychain and app-group data (from 0.18.1).
The website warns before signing an app it can't update without losing data (from 0.18.1).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.18.2

Re-signed apps keep their data: each app gets its own keychain, so apps like RyukGram stay signed in.
Apps signed under one App ID no longer share a keychain, where one app signing out signed the others out.
Each app keeps its own app-group folder under any profile, and an older sign's data is copied in once.
Website signing warns before Install when a profile group the app used is gone, or the app was signed under another ID.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.18.1

iOS 7 style, your own app icon, and an app icon that follows the theme.
Theme > Style: pick iOS 6 (default) or iOS 7.
Theme > App Icon: the icon follows your theme, or add your own picture (Photos or Files) and move and scale it.
Signed apps keep their app-group folders and keychain.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.18.0

Fixes installs and updates stuck on a blank Running page.
In the sideload app every install, update and re-sign run stopped on "Preparing" with no buttons. If 0.17.1 or 0.17.2 hangs updating itself, install this version from ifizbox.com in Safari.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.17.3

Fixes popup menus (Modify and others) whose buttons did nothing.
Action sheets in 0.17.1 stayed on screen with dead buttons after a tap, and a second tap stacked another one. Also includes everything merged since 0.17.1.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.17.2

Paid tweaks in sideloaded apps: sign in to Chariz or Havoc and buy, or get free purchased tweaks without signing in
Home warns in red when signing needs setup or the Signing Server is down; a Why iFizBox tile
A source that fails to refresh opens a page with the whole error and Refresh / Edit / Remove; BigBoss loads again
Pull to refresh holds open while it refreshes; notifications show iFizBox's icon; the launch screen matches the app
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.17.1

Tweaks in sideloaded apps: add APT and GitHub tweaks to any app you sign, no jailbreak
Add Tweaks on every app page: tweaks made for that app, ElleKit bundled, kept through updates
GitHub repos as sources: YTLite, BHTwitter, uYouEnhanced and more, straight from their releases
Find More Sources from Canister's repo index; Why iFizBox page; .ipa files open in iFizBox instead of unzipping
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.17.0

Tweak injection unpacks zstd and bzip2 .debs, and bundles ElleKit for tweaks that need Substrate
All Apps row on Sources and AltStore source pages: every app, newest version
Installation & Signing simplified: one Install Apps With row; faster This iPhone settings
Smoother: pages, sheets and alerts slide when they grow or shrink; fixes for cancelled installs and Paste
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.16.0

Inject tweaks when signing: add .dylib, .deb or .framework tweaks to any IPA
Safety nets: Known Safe / Trusted / Unknown labels on sources, an Unknown Source check when adding one
A one-time note before untrusted installs on iOS versions with public exploits, and Report as Malicious
Self-update on This iPhone closes iFizBox only once iOS is ready to install
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.15.0

Updates keep the App ID they were installed with, and signing is 3-4x faster
Big apps no longer fail to sign: 32-bit leftovers are skipped, memory use is down
Phone stays awake while installs and signing run
.ipa files opened from Safari's download preview land in My IPAs
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.14.0

Sideload queue fixes: the next queued app installs after iFizBox was suspended, and runs no longer end Failed: Cancelled on their own.
Installation & Signing settings redesigned, with This iPhone, Certificate, Signing Server and Signed Apps pages.
iFizBox's own update follows through to the end and clears its badge.
Settings > Account has Sign Out; Sideload Settings > Updates reworked, with Push on by default.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.13.0

Push notifications, Make Certificate, every capability for your own App IDs, and Developer Mode status.
Push notifications: turn on Settings > Updates > Push Notifications to be told about app updates from followed sources, new iFizBox versions and signatures about to expire. Test Push checks it works.
iFizBox keeps its own bundle ID when you sign it, so its notifications work.
Apple Developer Account works with or without a certificate. With an API key, Make Certificate creates an Apple Distribution certificate for you.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.12.0

Apple Developer Account: add an App Store Connect API key and iFizBox makes each app's App ID and Ad Hoc profile itself, with Push.
Settings > Installation & Signing is one page in the app; Remove Certificate sits beside Replace Certificate.
A hint shows how to see the install queue while apps wait in it.
Clearer wording on how signed apps get their own notifications.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.11.0

Install apps right on your iPhone: pair once, then This iPhone installs over LocalDevVPN or Tailscale.
Free Apple ID route: sign in with a free account and keep apps going with LiveContainer.
One-command computer setup for the free route (curl … | sh), no Docker and no GUI.
Pull to refresh on Sources, Changes and Home, and one search bar everywhere.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.10.0
